auth.title: Sign in
auth.intro: Welcome back. Sign in with the email or username your school gave you.
auth.helpText: Trouble signing in? Your school office can reset your account.

dashboard.noCurrentYearHelp: Add the school year and mark it as current to see term progress here.
dashboard.noTermToday: No term is in session today.
dashboard.noUpcoming: Nothing on the calendar for the next 60 days.
dashboard.memberIntro: Your school is setting things up. Sections in the menu open as soon as they are ready.

account.title: Your account
account.changePasswordIntro: Other devices signed in to your account will be signed out. This one stays signed in.
account.passwordHint: At least {{min}} characters. A short sentence is easy to remember.
account.passwordTooShort: The new password needs at least {{min}} characters.
account.forcedIntro: Hi {{name}}, you signed in with a temporary password from the school. Choose your own password to continue.
account.languageHelp: Used on this device. Your school administrator can change your default.

reset.requestIntro: Enter the email address you use to sign in. We will send you a link to choose a new password.
reset.requestSent: If an account uses this address, a reset link is on its way. It works for one hour.
reset.noEmailHelp: No email address? Ask the school office for a temporary password.
reset.done: Your password has been changed. You can sign in with it now.
reset.chooseIntro: Choose a password you have not used for this account before.

invite.title: Set up your account
invite.intro: Choose a password for your school account.
invite.done: Your account is ready. Sign in with your email address and the password you chose.
invite.askAdmin: Ask the school office to send you a new invitation.

users.title: Users & roles
users.intro: Staff, students and parents who can sign in, and what each of them may do.
users.empty: No users yet. Add staff first, then students and parents.
users.identifierHint: Use an email address if the person has one. Students without email can have a school username.
users.howToSignIn: How will they sign in the first time?
users.onboardingInviteHint: They get a link to choose their own password (valid for 3 days).
users.onboardingTemporaryHint: You hand it over in person. They must change it at first sign-in.
users.createdNotice: {{name}} was added. Give them the temporary password in person.
users.invitedNotice: {{name}} was added. The invitation email will be sent within a few minutes.
users.invitationPending: The invitation has not been accepted yet.
users.invitationResent: A new invitation will be sent within a few minutes. The old link no longer works.
users.temporaryPasswordHelp: Locked out, or no email? Set a temporary password and hand it over in person.
users.temporaryPasswordWarning: They will be signed out everywhere and must choose a new password at next sign-in.
users.temporaryPasswordSet: Temporary password set. They must change it when they next sign in.
users.disableHelp: Disabling signs them out everywhere and stops them signing in. Their records are kept.
users.disableConfirm: Disable {{name}}? They will be signed out immediately.
users.addIntro: Create an account and choose how the person signs in for the first time.
users.languageHint: Language of their emails and screens.
users.inviteNeedsEmail: Needs an email address. Use a temporary password for usernames.
users.rolesIntro: Roles decide what a person can see and do. You can change them later.
users.emptyHelp: Start with staff accounts, then add students and parents.
users.passwordTemporary: Temporary — must be changed at next sign-in
users.selfSecurityHint: To change your own password, use Your account.

academic.title: Academic setup
academic.intro: Years, terms, grades, subjects, classes, rooms, the bell schedule and the school calendar.
academic.label: Name
academic.name: Name
academic.inUse: In use (untick to retire without deleting)

years.title: Academic years
years.intro: One year is marked current; screens across the system default to it.
years.empty: No academic years yet. Add the current school year to begin.
years.emptyHelp: Add the current school year first; terms, classes and the calendar belong to a year.
years.isCurrentHint: Screens across the system default to the current year.

terms.title: Terms
terms.intro: Terms must fall inside the year and must not overlap.
terms.empty: No terms in this year yet.
terms.sequenceHint: 1 for the first term, 2 for the second, and so on.
terms.emptyHelp: Add each term with its first and last day.

grades.title: Grades
grades.intro: The grades this school teaches. Choose the subjects each grade takes.
grades.levelHint: Used for ordering: 1 for Grade 1, 13 for Grade 13.
grades.nameHint: As it appears on reports, for example Grade 6
grades.subjectsIntro: Tick the subjects this grade takes. Mark a subject optional if students choose it.
grades.emptyHelp: Add the grades your school teaches, for example Grade 1 to Grade 13.
grades.noSubjectsYet: Add subjects first (Subjects tab), then choose them here.

subjects.title: Subjects
subjects.intro: Subject names can be given in Sinhala and Tamil as well as English.
subjects.codeHint: Short and unique, for example MATH or SCI
subjects.emptyHelp: Add each subject once; then choose which grades take it.

classes.title: Classes
classes.intro: The class sections of each grade for a year, such as Grade 6 A.
classes.empty: No classes for this year and grade yet.
classes.needYear: Add an academic year first (Years & terms tab).
classes.sectionNameHint: For example A, B or Science
classes.emptyHelp: Create the sections of each grade for this year, such as 6 A and 6 B.

rooms.title: Rooms
rooms.intro: Classrooms, labs and halls used for classes and the timetable.
rooms.nameHint: For example Room 12 or Science lab

periods.title: Bell schedule
periods.intro: The periods of a school day. Periods must not overlap.
periods.emptyHelp: Add the periods and breaks of a school day in order.
periods.sequenceHint: Position in the day: 1 for the first period.

calendar.title: School calendar
calendar.intro: Holidays, term breaks, exam weeks and events.
calendar.empty: Nothing on the calendar for this year yet.
calendar.isSchoolDay: Classes are held on these days
calendar.yearHint: Leave empty for an event outside the school year.
calendar.emptyHelp: Add holidays, term breaks and exam weeks so everyone plans around them.
calendar.isSchoolDayHint: Untick for holidays and closures; attendance is not expected on those days.

academic.inUseHint: Untick to retire it without deleting history.

rollover.title: Copy classes into {{year}}
rollover.intro: Creates this year's class sections from another year's. Nothing changes until you confirm.
rollover.nothing: That year has no classes to copy.
rollover.note: Subjects are set per grade, so they apply to the new classes automatically. Students are not moved.

settings.title: School settings
settings.intro: How the school's name appears across the system.
settings.name: School name
settings.shortNameHint: Used where space is tight, such as phone screens and printouts.
settings.profileHelp: How the school is named on screens, emails and printouts.
settings.regionalHelp: Defaults for new users and for dates and times.
settings.defaultLanguageHint: New users start in this language; each person can change theirs.
settings.readOnly: You can view these settings. Only administrators can change them.

crud.deleteConfirm: Delete this {{noun}}? This cannot be undone.

errors.invalidCredentials: The email/username or password is incorrect.
errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.rateLimited: Too many requests. Please slow down.
errors.forbidden: You do not have access to this.
errors.csrf: Your session expired. Please reload the page.
errors.setupRequired: This school has not been set up yet.
errors.duplicate: An item with the same name or code already exists.
errors.inUse: This item is still in use and cannot be deleted. Mark it as not in use instead.
errors.invalidReference: A selected item no longer exists. Please refresh and try again.
errors.badRequest: The request could not be processed.
errors.passwordChangeRequired: Please choose a new password before continuing.
errors.invalidToken: This link is invalid or has expired. Please ask for a new one.
errors.lastAdmin: The school must keep at least one active administrator.
errors.cannotDisableSelf: You cannot disable your own account.
errors.useChangePassword: To change your own password, use Change password.
errors.notInvited: This account has already been activated.
errors.userDisabled: This account is disabled. Enable it first.
errors.internal: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.network: Cannot reach the server. Check your connection.

common.noAccessHelp: Your role does not include this section. Ask your school administrator if you need it.
common.notFoundHelp: The link may be old or mistyped.
common.offlineBody: Check your internet connection. Nothing has been lost; try again in a moment.

public.tagline: Classes, attendance, exams and results for your whole school, in one place.
public.factData: Your school's data stays in your school's own installation.
public.factLanguages: Works in English, සිංහල and தமிழ்.
public.factDevices: Designed for phones and slow connections.

roleHelp.school_admin: Manages users, roles, school settings and academic setup.
roleHelp.principal: Oversees the school; approves and publishes results.
roleHelp.academic_coordinator: Plans grades and subjects; moderates marks.
roleHelp.teacher: Takes attendance and enters marks for assigned classes.
roleHelp.registrar: Maintains student records and parent links.
roleHelp.student: Sees their own timetable, work and released results.
roleHelp.guardian: Sees their own children's attendance and released results.

table.tryOtherFilters: Try a different search or clear the filters.

placeholder.title: This section is on its way
placeholder.body: It is part of the school's build plan and is not available yet. Everything you see in the menu without a Soon label is ready to use.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.intro: Who did what, and when. Entries cannot be edited or deleted.
audit.detailsNote: Only names of fields, roles and ids are recorded — never passwords or the content of changes.

actions.academic_year_rolled_over: Classes copied into a new year

status.title: System status
status.intro: Backups, background jobs and the application, with what to do if something needs attention.
status.backupHelp: Backups are encrypted with the school's passphrase. Copy them off the server regularly.
status.jobsHelp: Emails such as invitations and password resets are sent by the scheduled job every few minutes.
status.emailFile: Not sending — saved on the server for testing

issues.noBackup: No backup has been made yet
issues.noBackupFix: Set a backup passphrase and add the daily backup job in the hosting control panel (see the backup guide).
issues.staleBackupFix: The daily backup job may have stopped. Check the scheduled job and its log in the hosting control panel.
issues.jobsOverdue_one: {{count}} background job is waiting longer than it should
issues.jobsOverdue_other: {{count}} background jobs are waiting longer than they should
issues.jobsOverdueFix: The scheduled job that sends emails is not running. Add or fix it in the hosting control panel.
issues.jobsFailedFix: Usually an email could not be sent. Check the mail server settings, then resend the invitation or reset.
issues.mailOffFix: Set the mail server settings (SMTP) so invitations and password resets reach people.
issues.setupFix: Run the first-time setup to create the school and its administrator.
